programme.desc: Andy debriefs his televised clash with Matt Goodwin over accusations that the Gorton and Denton by-election candidate used AI to research his book. Seán and Andy revisit the best moments of the debate, from Goodwin's evasive answers to his use of ChatGPT to defend himself.

programme.title: How The Taliban Really Works
programme.desc: Sean Langan is a British journalist and documentary filmmaker who has spent decades reporting from some of the world's most dangerous conflict zones, including Afghanistan, Iraq and Russia. He spent years covering the Taliban in his documentaries Fighting the Taliban, Meeting the Taliban and Afghan Ladies' Driving School.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right
programme.desc: Stephen Kapos is an 88-year-old Holocaust survivor who discusses his activism, his opposition to Israel's systemic destruction of Gaza and the West Bank, and how the memory of the Holocaust is being abused by Israel and the far-right.

programme.title: Ed Sheeran's Palestine Downfall
programme.desc: Ed Sheeran dropped Macklemore from his tour over the artist's pro-Palestine platform. He played his last gig alone, after all of his supporting artists and his backing band dropped out in solidarity. Ava and Seán break down what happened and react to Sheeran's apology.

programme.title: Did A GB News Host Write A Book Full Of AI Slop?
programme.desc: Andy investigates Matthew Goodwin's new book and uncovers significant issues with its content. After Goodwin's defeat in the Gorton and Denton by-election, his release is examined closely, with Andy and Ava challenging a series of claims that don't hold up. From questionable statistics about English language use in schools to references that appear to trace back to ChatGPT, the pair expose what is at the very least a lack of academic rigour.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.11
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Antelope

Some are easy to miss, the little dik-dik being barely the size of a house cat, while eland weigh in at more than half a ton. There are representatives roaming plains from the Mongolian Plateau in Asia to the cape of South Africa. Wherever you find them, these remarkable animals are the unsung heroes of the plains.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The East Auckland current warms the waters around the world-renowned Poor Knights Islands, creating an astonishing environment. Caves and arches hold the only known congregation of stingrays which stack themselves between underwater walls. Demoiselles and Black Angelfish fathers protect their eggs with determination, and must keep a watchful eye on neighbors who will raid their nests in an instant! When disaster strikes and the male Sandagers Wrasse disappears, one of the harem of females undergoes a sex change to pick up the missing male's responsibilities. On land, the Tuatara and Giant Weta fuel an ancient feud, while Gannets rest for their next attack.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters: Imire Rhino and Wild Life Conservancy

They track a black rhino and her calf on foot and Riley puts her skills as an anti-poacher to the test.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver's personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: From the Alps to Tuscany
programme.desc: Winter in north Italy: ice and snow rule over the Dolomites for months on end – only specialists can live up here in the high mountains: like the Ibex, for example. Hardly any other animal can climb so efficiently and scale the steepest slopes so elegantly. Even Ibex, however, descend to lower regions when the ice and snow are lying – the risk of falling is simply too high in winter. When an animal does succumb to the conditions, the Golden Eagle takes advantage. The ‘King of the Skies' becomes a scavenger in winter, when he can't catch prey himself - and he has to share, whether he likes it or not, as ravens and crows are quick to the scene of death. As soon as spring arrives, huge amounts of melt water plummet down from the Dolomites into the valley, feeding streams and rivers across north Italy – including the Po. At the Adriatic coast, Italy's longest river joins the Mediterranean and forms a vast delta. In the 1980's, salt-works were in operation here today however the area is a paradise for birds. The protected delta magically attracts rare water birds like the Purple Heron, and even Greater Flamingos. South of the Italian Alps sprawls one of the most recognizable cultural landscapes on earth: Tuscany. A mild climate, olive groves, vineyards and small woods shape this region – and whoever looks a little closer can also discover Tuscany's wild side. At the top of an old oak tree, two Stag Beetles clash for the favours of a lady and on a blooming meadow, a tortoise munches on some fresh flowers - totally at peace.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: New Girl in Town

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE

programme.desc: The chairman asks Inhyuk what is needed to establish a trauma center, leaving Inhyuk torn over whether to bring the highly skilled Euna onto the team. programme.title: Golden Time Ep.12
programme.desc: Confronted once again with moments of solitude and choice at the patient's bedside, Minwoo and Jaein are forced to reflect on what it truly means to face a life alone. Meanwhile, a patient with a shattered pelvis is rushed in, and Seongjin—who has fellowship experience in pelvic surgery—comes down from Orthopedics, only to hesitate over whether to proceed with the operation.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.13
programme.desc: During a dinner together, Inhyuk offers his congratulations to Euna and her fiancé, but an unmistakable tension lingers between the two men. Meanwhile, the ER is flooded with patients stung by jellyfish after a seaside outing—only to be thrown into further chaos when three men and women arrive with shotgun wounds.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.14
programme.desc: As Minwoo and Jaein clash over opposing views on amputating Wonguk's leg, the announcement of support for a new trauma center further clouds the decision on whether to proceed with surgery. Meanwhile, Minwoo struggles to understand Jaein's unusually sympathetic approach toward the kidnapper Yoo Seung-cheol.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.15
programme.desc: Though Wonguk's leg amputation is successfully completed and the team breathes a collective sigh of relief, Minwoo is left conflicted as he gazes at the severed limb. Watching Euna hand over her duties and prepare to leave for Canada, Inhyuk is overcome with memories from the past.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.16
programme.desc: When Daeje, suffering from severe headaches and unable to even stand, is rushed into the ER, tension grips the hospital. Unaware that Jaein is Daeje's granddaughter, Minwoo stays by her side, watching over a visibly shaken and distraught Jaein.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are four guys performing under the slogan of “chaotic world warm music” - it's Nerd Connection! This band is composed of four graduates of Yonsei University one of the most prestigious universities in Korea. The beginning was almost accidental - Vocalist Seo Yeong-ju and guitarist Choi Seung-won began performing together in 2012 as part of the university's rock band club Medusa. Then bassist Park Jae-hyun and drummer Shin Yeon-tae joined the band and they made their step into the professional music scene with their first single Hymn of the Birds in 2018. The same year they took part in the Emergenza Festival the world's largest festival for unsigned bands. After several regional qualifiers in Korea they passed the Korean qualification which led to the finals at a festival in Germany. With that unbelievable milestone at the very beginning stages of their career the four have pleasantly surprised listeners both at home and abroad until now. In October this year Nerd Connection released their first full-length album. All 12 songs in the album are tied under the concept of nostalgia for things gone by touching listeners in their unique way. In this episode the quartet performs 21st Century Kingdom Hollywood Movie Star Waterfall Bamboo Forest and Good Night Good Dream. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the four highly talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a band hoping to touch your heart - Touched! Touched is a quintet composed of guitarist D.on drummer Seung bin Kim vocalist and guitarist YunMin bassist John B.Kim and keyboardist Chae Dohyeon who are all graduates of Seoul Institute of the Arts. They are young as a band but they already have an impressive award-winning career. They won the Grand Prize at the 31st Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest in 2020 as the first band in the contest's history the Grand Prize at the 2021 Pyeongtaek National Band Comepetition the Grand Prize at the Hwaseong City Culture Foundation - RISING STAR 4U and another Grand Prize at the Gyeonggi Content Agency Indiestance. Having won three grand prizes in 2021 alone Touched is considered one of the hottest rookie bands in the Korean music scene. Also combining their intense rock energy with sensitive emotional modern rock the quintet is actively pushing their boundaries creating their own genre. In this episode Touched performs The Dawn Star Hi Bully Call Me Love is Dangerous and their cover of Blue which led them to win the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five talented artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is one of Korea's top bands MONNI! Composed of vocalist Kim Shin-eui bassist Lee In-kyoung guitarist Kong Tae-woo and drummer Jung Hun-tae the quartet made their debut in 2005 with the album One Day Light. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they quickly became known in the underground scene and soon impressed the general public through the music shows I'm A Singer Season 3 Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend King of Mask Singer and more. After a break of 7 years they released their fifth full-length album firmament in November this year. Capturing everything up in the sky from the sun to the moon to stars and light it offers a beautiful depiction of the band's identity that they have built for 17 years. In this episode MONNI performs Romantic Breeze Just so-so Tonight LOVESound as well as their new songs You were my star and Again. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out their new releases!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is sogumm famous for her unique voice and heartfelt music! This artist made herself known to the public through one TV competition show in 2019. Thanks to her wide musical spectrum and outstanding producing skills she won the competition and soon joined the record label AOMG. Of course she continued to pleasantly surprised listeners under the label. Her first album Sobrightttttttt earned both critical and commercial success and that success led her to win the coveted Rookie Prize at the 17th Korean Music Awards. She has also collaborated with a numner of A-list artists including ZICO Oh Hyuk 10CM DJ Wegun and Hoody and her ever-evolving artistry definitely makes us anticipate her future as a musician. In October this year sogumm released her full-length album Precious securing her unique spot in the industry. In this episode sogumm performs Insecurity Prescription Precious and more to show off the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. Così il corpo che le è sempre servito per lavorare, farsi ammirare e far godere, si rivolta contro di lei.

programme.title: Ecstasy
programme.desc: Moana cerca di aiutare la sorella minore Anna, chiusa in sé stessa e attratta da ambienti sempre più pericolosi. La ricerca della ragazza la conduce tra locali notturni, droga e rapporti difficili, fino a comprendere ciò di cui Anna ha davvero bisogno.

programme.title: Ingannevole è il cuore più di ogni cosa
programme.desc: Jeremiah, sette anni, è stato rimosso dalla sua famiglia adottiva e si ritrova immerso in una vita difficile in viaggio con sua madre, Sarah.

programme.title: All'armi, siam fascisti!
programme.desc: Mezzo secolo di storia, dal Cinquantenario al Centenario dell'Unità d'Italia, ricostruito con documenti di repertorio: dalla guerra di Libia alla pace di Versailles, dai tumulti del dopoguerra al terrore e alla corruzione fascista, dalla Resistenza ai fatti del luglio '60. Il film propone a conclusione questa domanda: il fascismo è veramente finito?

programme.title: Le ore dell'amore
programme.desc: Dopo tre anni di amore, Gianni e Maretta decidono di sposarsi. La routine coniugale spegne però la passione e li spinge verso goffi tentativi di evasione, finché capiscono di dover reinventare il loro rapporto.

programme.title: L'automobile
programme.desc: Anna Mastronardi (Anna Magnani) è una matura ex-prostituta diventata un'istituzione per la vita notturna romana, tanto che si fa chiamare contessa. D'altro canto la donna si sente sola e senza scopi. Decide quindi di comprarsi un'automobile per trovare un nuovo interesse, per soddisfare il suo bisogno di sentirsi una donna realizzata e per mettersi in evidenza di fronte a tutta Via Veneto.

programme.title: La notte
programme.desc: Nel corso di una sola giornata a Milano, uno scrittore e sua moglie attraversano ospedali, feste e incontri che mettono a nudo la crisi del loro matrimonio, la solitudine e l'incapacità di comunicare.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi torna sul set alla Festa del Cinema di Roma spazio a Se domani non torno Brad Pitt torna nei panni di Cliff Booth focus su Era meglio domani e interviste dal Capalbio Film Festival.

programme.title: La donna del giorno
programme.desc: Una giovane donna cerca di farsi strada nel mondo del lavoro e della vita sociale, ma si trova coinvolta in una relazione complicata con un uomo di potere che la sfrutta e la manipola per i propri fini.

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Tre ragazze condividono un sogno: fare fortuna. Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: L'orchestra rossa
programme.desc: L`orchestra rossa è la più importante rete di spie della seconda guerra mondiale. Si tratta di una storia incredibile ma assolutamente vera, che ricostruisce come un manipolo di audaci non professionisti di diverse nazionalità, senza alcuna esperienza sul campo, sia riuscito a tenere in scacco i nazisti sottraendo informazioni segretissime persino durante le riunioni di Hitler con i suoi generali

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler e suo marito Greg stanno cercando di trovare la scuola elementare giusta per il loro figlio di 4 anni, Jake. Descritto come gender-expansive dal suo consulente, il comportamento sempre più irregolare di Jake inizia a causare una spaccatura tra la coppia. Alex teme che gli adulti della sua vita lo stiano etichettando prematuramente, mentre Greg si chiede se la passione di Jake per i travestimenti non sia solo una fase.

programme.title: Angiò
programme.desc: Il film sperimentale è basato sul romanzo “Angiò uomo d'acqua” di Lorenzo Viani. Utilizza riprese dal vivo processate per avvicinarsi graficamente all'opera di Viani, pittore, incisore e autore di xilografie di rara forza espressiva, e racconta la storia di Angelo Bertuccelli, nato in via Pinciana a Viareggio, nel 1850. Piccolo di statura, con un carattere forte e orgoglioso in un fisico deforme, marinaio, come la maggior parte degli abitanti della Viareggio di allora, che scampato alla furia dei venti a bordo del “Dedalo”, fece voto di non affrontare più il mare. Così il “navigante dell'Oceano” consuma la sua vita sempre più isolato lontano dalla cattiveria della gente che irride il suo aspetto grottesco, in un turbinio di disperazione e ribellione. Il nano dal cuore di gigante, finirà la vita travolto dalle onde della follia, annegato in un mare profondo “un uomo d'acqua”, così come previsto da un destino ostile.

programme.title: Critical Thinking
programme.desc: Basato su una storia vera del 1998, cinque adolescenti latini e neri provenienti dal ghetto più difficile di Miami lottano per entrare nel campionato nazionale di scacchi sotto la guida del loro insegnante anticonvenzionale ma ispiratore.

programme.title: È arrivata mia figlia!
programme.desc: Val, governante devota, vede il suo equilibrio cambiare quando la figlia Jessica arriva con le sue ambizioni. Un film vincitore al Berlinale e al Sundance che esplora temi di classe e disuguaglianza, con un'interpretazione straordinaria di Regina Casé.

programme.title: Il Natale di Belle
programme.desc: È quasi Natale e Belle si trova a dover lasciare la California per un lavoro: la casa d'aste per cui lavora la manda nella villa di un cliente, Hunter Lowell, che sembrerebbe essere tutto fuorché amichevole. Belle lavora sodo: la magione è stupenda, il cliente un po' meno. Quando, però, i due cominciano a spendere più tempo assieme scocca la scintilla. Basterà questo a scaldare il suo cuore di ghiaccio?

programme.title: NATALE A HAPPY HOLLOW
programme.desc: I piani di una promotrice immobiliare incontrano un ostacolo quando scopre che ci sono molti proprietari di una fattoria di alberi di Natale che ha recentemente acquistato. Per salvare il suo progetto, deve collaborare con uno storico locale per convincere i proprietari a vendere le loro quote di terreno.

programme.title: UN NATALE IN VIGNA
programme.desc: Heather, conduttrice di “Read Between the Vines”, è determinata a creare il perfetto episodio natalizio presentando un'azienda vinicola unica della sua città natale. L'unica cosa che le ostacola il cammino? Rudy, l'affascinante e testardo proprietario dell'azienda vinicola.

programme.title: UN NATALE DA SCOPRIRE
programme.desc: Il Natale nella campagna inglese non era nei piani di Emma fino a quando sua sorella Amy non ha deciso di organizzare il suo matrimonio per la vigilia di Natale. Dylan, il socio di Amy nel mercatino di Natale, collabora con Emma per mettere ordine nel caos dei preparativi.

programme.title: White Flowers
programme.desc: A Roma un uomo si sveglia in una stanza d'albergo: ha una ferita alla testa e una pistola, ma non ricorda nulla della sua identità né del suo passato. Presto si accorge di essere in pericolo, inseguito da qualcuno che vuole ucciderlo.

programme.title: Big Baby
programme.desc: Uno scienziato inventa una macchina che agisce sui geni e trasforma il nipote di quattro anni in un adulto. Quando Bobby scappa di casa, i suoi fratelli devono riuscire a trovarlo prima del ritorno dei genitori. Il tempo stringe, rimane un solo giorno!

programme.title: Un Piccolo Grande Eroe
programme.desc: La storia di Alan, adolescente malato di poliomelite che desidera cavalcare e ha come mito personale il west e i cowboy. Dai racconti dell'australiano Allan Marshall, un film sulla giovinezza e su quanti ancora ne custodiscono in cuore il segreto.

programme.title: Senza santi in paradiso
programme.desc: Bob e Ruth sono una coppia di fuorilegge che vengono catturati dopo una sparatoria. Bob si prende la colpa dell'accaduto e Ruth viene rilasciata e porta avanti una gravidanza. Dopo quattro anni Bob evade per conoscere la figlia mai vista finora.

programme.title: 2012: Supernova
programme.desc: In una galassia non lontana dalla Terra una stella si sta trasformando in Supernova. Mentre le microonde emesse dal gigante stellare minacciano il Pianeta, uno scienziato escogita un disperato piano di salvezza. C'è ancora una speranza per l'umanità.

programme.title: Premonitions
programme.desc: L'agente speciale dell'FBI Joe Merriwether non riesce a fare luce su una misteriosa catena di delitti. Ingaggia così un suo ex collaboratore in pensione, il medico psicanalista John Clancy, allo scopo di risolvere il caso.

programme.title: Knight of cups
programme.desc: Il padre era solito leggere al figlio Rick (Christian Bale), ancora ragazzino, questa storia: “C'era una volta un giovane principe che il padre inviò in Egitto a cercare una perla. Ma, quando il principe arrivò, la gente gli porse una coppa.

programme.title: Hesher è stato qui
programme.desc: T.J. è un ragazzino a cui è morta da due mesi la madre in un incidente stradale. La vita familiare è stata sconvolta dal decesso: il padre Paul vegeta in depressione in casa e la nonna cerca in qualche modo di accudire i due sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Breaking Up
programme.desc: Il fotografo in difficoltà Steve e l'insegnante Monica scoprono l'eccitante amore di una vita che tutti sognano.

programme.title: La casa del diavolo
programme.desc: Sequel del sanguinoso 'La casa dei mille corpi', la psicotica famiglia Firefly vaga senza meta, lasciando sulla strada una scia di morte e distruzione. È, però, braccata da uno sceriffo feroce e due cacciatori di taglie senza scrupoli: la caccia sarà spietata.

programme.title: Halloween The Beginning
programme.desc: Il feroce assassino Michael Meyers viene rilasciato dall'istituto psichiatrico in cui è stato rinchiuso per 17 anni e si scatena alla ricerca della sorella minore. Questo significa solo una cosa: nessuno è al sicuro!

programme.title: Ghost stories
programme.desc: Il professor Goodman è un docente di psicologia che non crede ai fenomeni soprannaturali. L'arrivo di una misteriosa lettera che contiene informazioni si tre casi mai risolti lo porterà a imbarcarsi in un viaggio alla scoperta di ciò che non può essere spiegato razionalmente.

programme.title: Una voce nella notte
programme.desc: Uno speaker radiofonico riceve strane telefonate da un ragazzo misterioso. Ma dietro la voce si nasconde un segreto inquietante. Thriller psicologico con Robin Williams.

programme.title: In salute e in malattia
programme.desc: La pasticcera Helena avvelena gli uomini che non soddisfano i suoi canoni elevati. Il suo fidanzato Charlie non sembrerebbe avere nulla di cui preoccuparsi, fino a quando la sorella Becca non si insospettisce riguardo il passato di culinaria assassina di Helena. Spetta a Becca salvare Charlie, sia dall'altare che dalla tomba.

programme.title: Ambizioni pericolose
programme.desc: Nel tentativo di aiutare la figlia a diventare capitano della squadra di cheerleader, una madre scopre che qualcuno sta somministrando misteriosi integratori alla ragazza e che è disposto a tutto pur di non farsi scoprire, persino uccidere.

programme.title: Disaster zone
programme.desc: Un esperimento illegale apre una riserva di magma nascosta sconosciuta direttamente sotto Manhattan con risultati catastrofici.

programme.title: A Romance Wedding
programme.desc: Zoe Davis è un'ambiziosa organizzatrice di matrimoni di successo nella grande città dove vive. Quando suo padre le chiede di aiutarla nel bar di famiglia, è felice di tornare nella sua accogliente città natale, Romance, in Oregon. Non sa però che sua madre ha già assunto Will, un aspirante chef e, guarda caso, il fidanzato d'infanzia di Zoe! La tensione tra Zoe e Will aumenta tanto quanto la chimica tra loro. Riusciranno i due ad appianare le divergenze e trovare l'amore perduto lungo la strada?

programme.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Nick pensa di aver trovato il paradiso quando raggiunge il fratello in Colombia. Una laguna turchese, una spiaggia d'avorio, onde perfette - è un sogno per questo giovane surfista canadese. Poi incontra Maria, una splendida ragazza colombiana.

programme.title: Here After
programme.desc: Uno sguardo oscuro sul significato dell'amore nell'aldilà.

programme.title: Qui dove batte il cuore
programme.desc: Una diciassettenne incinta ricostruisce la propria vita dopo essere stata abbandonata dal suo ragazzo in un Walmart a Sequoyah, in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Becoming Jane
programme.sub-title: Il ritratto di una donna contro
programme.desc: Jane Austen è una ventenne romantica e indipendente nell'Inghilterra del 1795. Jane sogna un matrimonio d'amore mentre sua madre è ansiosa di accasarla con un aristocratico facoltoso. L'arrivo di Tom Lefroy, affascinante ma privo di mezzi, sconvolgerà gli equilibri della piccola comunità locale.

programme.title: A proposito dei ricardo
programme.desc: Lavorando a "Lucy ed io", Lucille Ball e Desi Arnaz affrontano una serie di crisi che minacciano il loro show, le loro carriere e il loro matrimonio.

programme.title: Black Water Abyss
programme.desc: Un gruppo di quattro amici stanno esplorando un sistema di caverne, ma rimangono bloccati all'interno delle grotte. Il problema non sarà soltanto l'allagamento e la mancanza di ossigeno, ma anche un branco di famelici alligatori pronti a dar loro la caccia

programme.title: Drag me to hell
programme.desc: Dopo aver affrontato una scelta difficile sul lavoro, Christine viene perseguitata da un'anziana signora che, per vendicarsi, le lancerà contro una potente maledizionei, trasformando la sua vita in un vero inferno.

programme.title: Mancino Naturale
programme.desc: Isabella è vedova da tre anni e vive in un modesto appartamento a Latina con Paolo, il figlio dodicenne, sul quale ha riversato tutte le sue aspettative.

programme.title: Once Upon a Wedding
programme.desc: Una settimana prima del suo matrimonio, una donna ferisce un uomo in un incidente stradale. Mentre si prende cura di lui, inizia a dubitare di aver fatto le scelte giuste nella vita.

programme.title: Turbolenze damore
programme.desc: Durante un volo da New York a Parigi, Antoine si ritrova seduto proprio accanto alla propria ex ragazza con la quale ha avuto una brutta rottura tre anni prima. I due rivivono così gli alti e bassi della relazione che hanno avuto.

programme.title: La regina del Natale
programme.desc: Ashley Mackenzie è la principale "Regina del Natale" in città. Il suo approccio tradizionale alle vacanze è sempre un successo: dalla realizzazione di decorazioni fatte a mano per la boutique all'ospitare l'annuale concorso di maglioni natalizi della città. Questo fino a quando non incontra la sua anima gemella in Ben Williams, un esperto tecnico che è stato assunto per modernizzare l'approccio del negozio. Ashley e Ben si scontrano su come creare la migliore cartolina di Natale per i dipendenti finché non si imbattono nella perfetta cartolina elettronica video che finisce per diventare virale! Riuscirà l'amore condiviso di Ashley e Ben per il Natale a essere sufficiente per unirli e fargli realizzare i veri sentimenti che provano l'uno per l'altro?

programme.title: Amore a Cedar Creek
programme.desc: Allison Sawyer è una giornalista che scrive del suo autore preferito che ha basato tutti i suoi romanzi sul bellissimo Clybourne Ranch. Lì incontra Hank che gestisce il posto da anni. Mentre Allison scrive, diventa anche molto più vicina a Hank...

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri
programme.desc: Con un grande cast, girato tra Vienna, Londra, Parigi, New York, l'Arizona e Rio de Janeiro, il film racconta quanti incontri, opportunità, scelte e decisioni ci si presentano nel corso di una vita.

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri
programme.desc: Con un grande cast, girato tra Vienna, Londra, Parigi, New York, l'Arizona e Rio de Janeiro, il film racconta quanti incontri, opportunità, scelte e decisioni ci si presentano nel corso di una vita.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: L'imperdibile viaggio di Harold Fry
programme.desc: Harold è un uomo qualunque che ha sempre vissuto senza prendere iniziative. Un giorno scopre che una vecchia amica è molto malata e decide di andarla a trovare attraversando a piedi l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: Tutto Ciò che Voglio
programme.desc: Wendy è Autistica, viene aiutata dalla terapia della struttura specializzata di Scottie, proteggendo la sua rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva Star Trek.

programme.title: Un affare di famiglia
programme.desc: Dopo una delle loro sessioni di taccheggio, Osamu e il figlio si imbattono in una bambina lasciata al freddo. Seppur dapprima riluttante, la moglie di Osamu accetta di prendersene cura dopo avere appreso le difficoltà che la piccola deve affrontare. Sebbene la famiglia sia povera e guadagni solo lo stretto necessario per sopravvivere, tutti sono felici finché un incidente imprevisto porta alla luce segreti tenuti ben nascosti, mettendo alla prova ogni legame.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: Il Rompiscatole
programme.desc: Solitamente dando una mancetta di $50 al tecnico televisivo si possono vedere gratis tutti i canali desiderati. Ma quando Steven Kovacs (Matthew Broderick) trasloca, scopre che il tecnico della tv (Jim Carrey) è diverso. Non vuole i 50 verdoni, ma diventare amico di Steven.

programme.title: Una ragazza sfrenata
programme.desc: Un'ereditiera insoddisfatta è il bersaglio di un insospettabile ladro d'auto che viene trascinata inavvertitamente in un complotto per sequestrarla

programme.title: Stir Crazy (1980)
programme.desc: Quando l'aspirante commediografo di Broadway Skip Donahue e il suo migliore amico, l'attore disoccupato Harry Monroe, vengono licenziati, partono con il loro scassato furgone per Hollywood in cerca di fortuna. Ma il furgone si rompe lungo il tragitto e sono costretti ad accettare un lavoraccio di promozione in costume per una banca. I loro guai sono appena iniziati: due ladri rubano i loro costumi piumati e li usano per fare una rapina...

programme.title: Cambia La Tua Vita Con Un Click
programme.desc: Michael Newman è sposato con la bellissima Donna e ha due bambini che non riesce a vedere molto a causa del lavoro. Alla ricerca del telecomando perfetto, Michael finisce nel retro di un negozio Bed, Bath & Beyond, dove un commesso gli dà un nuovo telecomando che cambierà la sua vita: riesce ad accendere ogni tipo di apparecchio con un clic e scopre che ha anche altre sorprendenti funzioni.

programme.title: Furto di sera bel colpo si spera
programme.desc: Quinto, ladro sfortunato, passa dalle auto ai salumi e ai quadri, finendo sempre in ospedale o in galera

programme.title: Le piacevoli notti di Justine
programme.desc: Nell'Ottocento, due attori girovaghi aprono un locale equivoco, sfidano il governatore

programme.title: Sesso e volentieri
programme.desc: Dieci piccoli episodi collegati dal filo rosso del ""sesso e volentieri""

programme.title: Io tigro tu tigri egli tigra
programme.desc: Film a episodi con Renato Pozzetto, Cochi Ponzoni, Paolo Villaggio ed Enrico Montesano

programme.title: La donna più bella del mondo
programme.desc: Gina Lollobrigida interpreta una donna affascinante e ambiziosa che cerca di farsi strada nel mondo dello spettacolo. Tra amori e tradimenti, la sua bellezza diventa sia un vantaggio che una trappola, esplorando la superficialità e le difficoltà della fama.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: Fifa e arena
programme.desc: Commedia di Mario Mattoli con Totò e Isa Barzizza: per un equivoco Nicolino è scambiato per un criminale e fugge a Siviglia. Tra gag, travestimenti e corrida, combinano guai esilaranti in una Spagna tutta napoletana.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: Hansel & Gretel e la strega della foresta nera
programme.desc: Agnes (Lara Flynn Boyle), affascinante e seducente strega, rapisce adolescenti usando la marijuana. Li attira nella sua casa di periferia e provvede ad ucciderli per poi mangiarli: questo il segreto per mantenere intatte la bellezza e la giovinezza che la contraddistinguono.

programme.title: Sex Movie In 4d
programme.desc: Ian ha 18 anni ed è pronto a tutto pur di perdere la verginità. Ruba la macchina di suo fratello maggiore e attraversa gli Stati Uniti deciso ad andare incontro al suo destino. Il viaggio, dopo innumerevoli e spassose disavventure, si trasforma in un'esperienza capace di cambiargli la vita.

programme.title: Il mio uomo è una canaglia
programme.desc: George Segal e Karen Black interpretano magistralmente un eroinomane e la ragazza dallo spirito libero che gli fa desiderare di cambiare vita. Paula Prentiss e Robert De Niro sono tra gli interpreti di questo dramma che unisce comicità e tragedia.

programme.title: Comportamenti Molto Cattivi
programme.desc: Il sedicenne Rick Stevens non desidera altro che conquistare il cuore di Nina Pennington, la ragazza dei suoi sogni ed è pronto a tutto pur di riuscirci. Si ritroverà, però, coinvolto in una serie di avvenimenti del tutto fuori dagli schemi.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Spedito nella fattoria di bestiame del nonno, situata nella remota regione di Pilbara, nell'Australia occidentale, l'undicenne Mick si prepara a una vita di noiosi stenti. Non si aspetta un cane che cambierà per sempre il corso della sua esistenza.

programme.title: Abe
programme.desc: Un ragazzo unisce le culture della sua famiglia nei piatti che impara a preparare insieme ad uno chef di Brooklyn.

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: Valentin è un playboy di Acapulco. Un giorno sulla sua porta viene lasciata una bambina e l'uomo decide di crescerla come fosse sua, cambiando così stile di vita ed arrivando a conquistare Hollywood come stuntman.

programme.title: Another Happy Day
programme.desc: Alla vigilia del matrimonio di suo figlio, Lynn, una donna che ha sempre nascosto le sue emozioni, insieme ai suoi tre figli dovrà fare i conti con le montagne russe emotive di una riunione di famiglia. Una commedia oscura con Ellen Barkin e Demi Moore.

programme.title: Le avventure di Mary Read
programme.desc: Mary Read, avventuriera del Seicento, passa dalla strada alla pirateria fino a diventare capitano corsaro. Nel corso delle sue imprese non dimentica Peter, il nobile incontrato anni prima nelle prigioni di Londra.

programme.title: I pirati dell'isola verde
programme.desc: Tra arrembaggi e intrighi nei mari tropicali, un audace pirata si scontra con nemici e tradimenti nella lotta per il dominio e la libertà.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Ettore Fieramosca
programme.desc: Nell'Italia rinascimentale, il valoroso Ettore Fieramosca guida i cavalieri italiani nella celebre sfida contro i francesi, tra onore, rivalità e spirito patriottico.

programme.title: L'assedio di Siracusa
programme.desc: Tra assedi, strategie e passioni, Siracusa resiste all'avanzata romana in una sfida che decide il destino della città. Con Sylva Koscina.

programme.title: W Django!
programme.desc: Django è sulle tracce di alcuni fuorilegge rinnegati che hanno violentato e ucciso sua moglie. Durante il viaggio, salva un ladro di cavalli da un'improvvisa impiccagione. Scopre che l'uomo sa chi ha commesso l'omicidio. Gli uomini si uniscono e si dirigono a ovest per vendicarsi.

programme.title: I 4 inesorabili
programme.desc: Il Texas Ranger Garrett cerca di scagionare Calhoun, ma finisce incastrato da quattro cacciatori di taglie. Lasciato a morire nel deserto e accusato di omicidio, evade di prigione e deve ora affrontare i veri colpevoli mentre ha una taglia sulla testa. Per lui inizia una corsa disperata per la verità e la sopravvivenza.

programme.title: Bill il Taciturno
programme.desc: Django arriva a Santa Anna su richiesta di Sanders, ucciso poco dopo, mentre il rivale Thompson tenta trattative con il bandito El Santo. Dopo un breve legame con la vedova Linda, custode di segreti su una miniera d'oro, Django accetta di scortare un carico attraverso il pericoloso territorio di El Santo.

programme.title: ...e venne il tempo di uccidere
programme.desc: Un giovane vicesceriffo cerca di riportare la sbornia e rivitalizzare uno sceriffo alcolizzato e sfinito per abbattere un paio di bande di criminali in guerra nel Vecchio West.

programme.title: Le quattro facce del West
programme.desc: Nel Nuovo Messico, un cowboy costringe un banchiere sotto la minaccia di una pistola a concedergli un prestito senza garanzie, in cambio di una cambiale, ma lo sceriffo e la sua posse lo inseguono.
